title: Spillage reported up the chain, told to go away, file deleted

tellings.quote: he basically recommended to me, delete that and pretend he never saw it, and then he just left the room.

plain: Matthew Brown, who says he worked inside the Pentagon, says that around 2018 he came across "spillage", meaning secret material turning up where it shouldn't, tied to a briefing on a hidden programme he calls Immaculate Constellation. He says he reported it up the chain, including to the office that oversees the Pentagon's most secret programmes, and that a superior advised him to "delete that and pretend he never saw it" and then walked out of the room. If true, it would mean officials were actively burying records about unexplained craft.
